# ls

List directory entries through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/ls

moonx cli/ls -A -1 source-dir

moonx cli/ls -R source-dir
```

Select hidden entries, layout, quoting and sorting explicitly. Paths are listed using the supported byte-oriented naming profile.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-a`, `--all` | Include hidden entries, including dot and dot-dot. |
| `-A`, `--almost-all` | Include hidden entries except dot and dot-dot. |
| `-d`, `--directory` | List directory operands themselves. |
| `-F`, `--classify` | Append file-type indicators. |
| `-R`, `--recursive` | List subdirectories recursively. |
| `-1`, `--one` | Print one entry per line. |
| `--color VALUE` | Explicit always or never color; bare flag means always. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- Long listings and ownership, inode, permission or capability metadata are unsupported.
- Automatic terminal color is unavailable; select --color=always or never. -P is a project extension.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
